source.title: NCTCOG Recommended Amendments to the 2021 International Residential Code (Approved July 2021)

plainLanguage: Arlington adopted the 2021 International Residential Code with local changes in November 2022, with the 2021 energy and plumbing codes and (most likely) the 2020 electrical code. Most new homes are in the RS-7.2 district: 7,200 sq ft lots, 60 ft wide. The house sits at least 20 ft back from a local street (40 ft from a major road), 15 ft from a side street, and about 5 ft from side neighbors, with a 20 ft rear yard. Height can go to 40 ft and the house can cover up to half the lot. In a floodplain, the floor and any finished garage must be 2 ft above the city's future-development flood level, which is stricter than the FEMA map. Expect water ($828) and sewer ($418) impact fees plus a roadway impact fee that depends on your area. The permit runs roughly $2,100-2,300 for a 2,400 sq ft home including plan review. Clay soils usually call for an engineer-designed slab.
